TRAINING ACADEMY (new)
Menu > Academy, code 101. Identify each creature into its numbered slot, then Assess for ticks and crosses. Tap a cross for details.

BELTS (new)
Get every creature right in an Academy session to earn a belt: a ribbon across the top-right corner of the Menu screen. It now saves to your account — sign in, earn one, reinstall, and it should come back. If it does not, that is worth reporting.

WHICH QUESTION DID I GET WRONG (fixed)
After an Academy assessment, tap a cross and then the which-question prompt. It should land on the couplet where those two creatures actually part, on the path you walked — not somewhere you never went.

TRAY BUTTON (new)
Deep in the key, the ice cube button takes you back to the tray you came from, training or survey. It is absent if you entered the key from the menu.

SYNC FEEDBACK
Sync on the samples list: progress bar and a Show Logs pane. Try it with the network off — it should queue and retry rather than fail.
